player_prompt.intro:
Nde Player {player_id} **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**-pe.
Egreso ne ñembogue **[macro  micro]** (mokõi papapy 0-8):
• *macro*  = moõmini-tablero-pe oñeha'ã
• *micro* = moõ cuadrado mini-tablero ryepýpe
Techapyrã `[7 8]` ➜ emoha'ã ne ra'ãnga mini-tablero 7-pe, cuadrado 8-pe, ha
emohatã oponente oñeha'ã mini-tablero 8-pe upe rire.

Nde `{symbol}`.
